spans.s: घरट्ट m. A grinding stone, e.g. रे रे घरट्ट मा रोदीः कं कं न भ्रामयंत्यमूः । कटाक्षवीक्षणादेव कराकृष्टस्य का कथा.
घर्घर (I) a. (f. रा) Indistinct, gurgling (as a sound), घर्घररवा पारेश्मशानं सरित् M.M.v.
घर्घर (II) m. 1. An indistinct murmur, a low murmuring noise (as of a घरट्ट); 2. noise in general; 3. a door, a gate; 4. laughter; 5. an owl.
घर्घर (I) a. (f. रा) Indistinct, gurgling (as a sound), घर्घररवा पारेश्मशानं सरित् M.M.v.
घर्घरा f. 1. A bell used as an ornament; 2. a girdle of small bells; 3. the Ganges.
घर्घरा f. 1. A bell used as an ornament; 2. a girdle of small bells; 3. the Ganges.
घर्घरिका f. 1. A bell used as an ornament; 2. a kind of musical instrument.
घर्घरित n. the grunting of a hog.
घर्म m. 1. Heat, warmth; 2. the hot season, निश्वासहार्यांशुकमाजगाम घर्मः प्रिय्वेशमिवोपदेष्टुम् R.xvi.43; 3. sweat, perspiration; 4. a boiler.
घर्म-अंशु m. the sun.
घर्म-अंत m. the rainy season.
घर्म-अंबु, -अंभस् n. sweat, perspiration, M.M.i.
घर्म-अंबु, -अंभस् n. sweat, perspiration, M.M.i.
घर्म-चर्चिका f. erruptions caused by heat and oppressed perspiration.
घर्म-दीधिति m. the sun, R.xi.64.
घर्म-द्युति m. the sun, Kir.v.41.
घर्म-पयस् n. sweat, perspiration, Sis.ix.35.
घर्ष m. 1. Rubbing; 2. grinding.
घर्षण n. 1. Rubbing; 2. grinding.
घार m. Sprinkling, wetting.
घार्तिक m. A cake prepared with clarified butter which has small holes all over. (In the Panchatantra, a learned fool is made to apply the maxim ‘छिद्रेष्वनर्था बहुलीभवंति’ to this sweetmeat.)
